thread:
maria: Heads-up — CX bank asked for 10-year immutable audit logs + signed export (NDJSON + manifest). Are we already scoping long-term evidence retention for enterprise?
ben: We have retention tiers but not an immutable, signed snapshot >1y. That would need BYOK/KMS tie-in and manifest signing.
sarah: @maria do they explicitly require WORM/immutable storage or just 'verifiable chain of custody' for audits? SOC2/ISO wording matters here.
kevin: From infra: cold storage + append-only snapshots is doable. Search SLA over 10y is expensive. Alternative: provide signed, downloadable archives for evidence requests to avoid paying for searchable indexing forever.
maria: :thumbsup: Customer specifically said "verify chain of custody" and wants periodic snapshots they can independently verify.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: retention-config v0.9 pushed to staging for validation :rocket:
jonathan: Security note — key rotation and escrow windows are critical. If customer-supplied KMS, we need attestation + rotation policy in acceptance criteria. Also preserve signature verification tooling.
ben: Prototype retention config snippet for discussion:

```
retention:
  tier: evidentiary
  duration: 10y
  immutability: true
  signed_by: customer-kms
  export_format: ndjson+manifest
``` 

kevin: Agree with archive approach. Tradeoff: much lower runtime cost but slower retrieval path. Also need clear SLAs for "export generation" time (EOD vs hours).
maria: Product decision: we need proposed pricing for an "evidence-tier" add-on (long-term immutable exports) vs Dedicated reserved capacity. Will surface to sales for CX bank.
sarah: Action items: 1) Product to draft acceptance criteria + UX for export request flow; 2) Legal to confirm WORM semantics and required attestations; 3) Eng/SRE to estimate storage and export CPU cost.
kevin: I'll run a cost model (storage + cold-retrieval + manifest signing ops) and post numbers by EOW.
maria: Also: add PII/token redaction options to export ACs — must support selective redaction before signing.
jonathan: Noted. I'll add key-escrow, HSM attestation, and verification tool requirements to the compliance epic.
ben: Small UX question — do we need an "export preview" checksum step so customers can validate before final sign? Could reduce disputes.
maria: Good idea. Put that in the AC list.
sarah: OK I'll create the PRD stub and drop it in the compliance epic. Thanks everyone.
